r: Generates modules.yaml file with a module, that provides all RPM packages that are available within a repository.

repo_path
modules_yaml
--debug
--nodebug
-n MODULE_NAME, --module-name MODULE_NAME
Default is the current directory name
-s MODULE_STREAM, --module-stream MODULE_STREAM
-v MODULE_VERSION, --module-version MODULE_VERSION
-c MODULE_CONTEXT, --module-context MODULE_CONTEXT
-O, --to-stdout
The latest version of repo2module may be downloaded from HOMEPAGE
